Definition: Kenaan, a son a Ham; also the country inhabited by him
BiblicalUsage: Kenaan is both a man, the son of Ham, and the land his children inhabited: Genesis 12:5 says Abram went forth to go into the land of Canaan, and into the land of Canaan they came. 1 Chronicles 1:8 lists the sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan. Zephaniah 2:5 cries woe to Canaan, the land of the Philistines, for the word of the LORD is against you.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Canaan holds both the promise and the judgment: the land God gave, and the land God judged when its sins were full.
